newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude dips in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude dips in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude dipped in late U.S. paper trading on Tuesday, extending the day's heavy losses, traders said.
A full boat of July Brent changed hands at $19.88 a barrel, down two cents from the settlement of London's IPE.
Six partial cargoes of July Brent traded a total of 550 times between $18.83 and $18.88 a barrel.
July/August Brent was dealt twice at minus 16 cents a barrel, even with a deal earlier in the day.
